# NCI CORE RESET CMD
send 20000100

# NCI CORE INIT CMD
send 2001020000

# NCI SYSTEM ENABLE PROPRIETARY CMD
send 2F0200

# NCI Disable standby mode
send 2F000100

# Start Continuous RF ON
send 2F3D022001

# 查TXLDO电流
exec 0 2F32020814 4F32

#Tx：2F320108
#Rx：4F320300013A，电流值：013A = 314mA （RSP最后2byte直接16进制转10进制即可）

print int 4 6 current: %dmA
